notes: I diffed the working copy against the original. The only code changes are the mirrored FRAME_D start (right-edge midpoint, two-headed dash timing unchanged), perspectiveOrigin 42% to 58%, negated rotateY/rotateZ, gradient 150deg to 30deg, mirrored boxShadow x offsets, a row-reverse sidebar on the right with its divider on the sidebar's left, and the search-row and avatar margins. Timings, easing, seed, fps, size and exports are untouched. I rendered frames 0, 6, 10, 16, 22, 28, 34, 44, 56, 66, 90, 110, 120 and the existing 149 and compared them with the originals. The card has no text and no raster assets, so there is no shaping, font or leftover-text risk (Vazirmatn is loaded but unused, and the author reported this honestly). The mirrored composition is consistent: the near edge of the panel is now on the left, the sidebar is on the right, the chip grid fills from the right, the avatars are at the left end of the table rows, and the landing stagger and shadows read like the source. The motion beats match. The one visible flaw is the unmirrored frame-stroke gradient. There is no cheating (no blur or hiding). Shippable.
